title: Glowing pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='glow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffbe0'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffe46b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='halo' cx='0.5' cy='0.5' r='0.5'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe46b' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffb800' stop-opacity='0.22'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb800' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='44' fill='url(#halo)'/>

  <!-- pencil body -->
  <g transform='translate(50 50) rotate(-35)'>
    <!-- wooden body -->
    <rect x='-7' y='-34' width='14' height='50' rx='1.5' fill='#ffcf4d'/>
    <!-- lighter face of the body for definition -->
    <rect x='-7' y='-34' width='5' height='50' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe89a'/>
    <!-- seam line (lighter yellow) -->
    <rect x='1.5' y='-34' width='1.4' height='50' fill='#e6a92e'/>

    <!-- ferrule (metal band) -->
    <rect x='-7' y='11' width='14' height='9' rx='1' fill='#b8c6d9'/>
    <rect x='-7' y='11' width='5' height='9' rx='1' fill='#e2eaf5'/>
    <rect x='-7' y='13.5' width='14' height='1.4' fill='#8b9cb3'/>
    <rect x='-7' y='16.5' width='14' height='1.4' fill='#8b9cb3'/>

    <!-- eraser -->
    <rect x='-6.5' y='20' width='13' height='9' rx='4' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
    <rect x='-6.5' y='20' width='4.5' height='9' rx='3' fill='#ffc2cd'/>

    <!-- sharpened tip -->
    <polygon points='-7,-34 7,-34 0,-46' fill='#ffe0b3'/>
    <polygon points='-7,-34 0,-34 0,-46' fill='#fff0d6'/>

    <!-- graphite core -->
    <polygon points='-2.6,-41.2 2.6,-41.2 0,-46' fill='#5b3fa8'/>
    <polygon points='-2.6,-41.2 0,-41.2 0,-46' fill='#8a6bd6'/>

    <!-- glowing sparkle at the tip -->
    <circle cx='0' cy='-46.5' r='3.6' fill='#fff6c2' opacity='0.9'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='-46.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- little sparkles around the tip -->
  <g fill='#fff6c2'>
    <path d='M28 10 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M70 20 l1.4 3.6 l3.6 1.4 l-3.6 1.4 l-1.4 3.6 l-1.4 -3.6 l-3.6 -1.4 l3.6 -1.4 z' opacity='0.85'/>
    <path d='M60 78 l1.4 3.6 l3.6 1.4 l-3.6 1.4 l-1.4 3.6 l-1.4 -3.6 l-3.6 -1.4 l3.6 -1.4 z' opacity='0.75'/>
  </g>
</svg>
